scientific_integrity: Proof by diagonal-Fourier decomposition, exact cubic fiber enumeration and Vandermonde rank; finite checker corroborates selected cases but is not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Prime dimensions p>=5, r consecutive quartic-phase masks, exact noiseless full Fourier profiles, arbitrary Hermitian matrices; no nonlinear phase retrieval or noise-stability claim.
title: Exact arithmetic saturation of quartic-phase masked Fourier tomography
